positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Designed and developed room modules and developed / tested new room data entry / reporting system using Visual Basic.

positions.title: Application Developer
positions.description:
Produced programming in ASP.NET and VB .NET 2003, creating applications and web services.
· Accomplished database work in SQL Server 2000, creating tables, stored procedures, and DTS packages.
· Created applications with classes in them to isolate code that could be reused in other programs / projects.
· Delivered a website for students to register for classes and enter their shipping information for textbooks.
· Devised a web application that gave the Program Directors, Financial Aid, and Registrars the ability to review and approve course lists for students.
· Designed and implemented integration between this and a third-party application (WebCT) to automatically create student accounts and set up the course list for the student.
· Provided a CRM desktop solution, migrated data from Siebels, that used SQL Server 2000 and web services to integrate with an in-house database and update from a web server.
· Created a desktop application that used web services to query student information from a web server that included student information, Classes in WebCT, Book Orders, etc.
· Created a website for the student enrollment process that included the creation of documents in PDF format as students filled out the required forms, and then redirected the student to a third-party site for Financial Aid.
· Created integration with this third-party site to preload data for students using web services.
· Created an administration tool for the enrollment website to enable the Admissions Department to see their students’ progress on the enrollment website and obtain the documents signed by the student.
· Maintained a website that had web pages for announcements and help pages for students.
· Managed WebCT, a site where students took classes, when needed.
· Wrote DTS packages in SQL 2000 that created excel sheets of students’ books to order with the ISBN and the shipping addresses and an automated process to send these lists to the book vendors.

positions.title: System Analyst
positions.description:
Executed programming in .NET, writing SQL Server Reporting Services reports and stored procedures in SQL Server.
· Designed, created, and deployed SSRS Reports to the SSRS.
· Designed, created, and implemented data migrations using .NET and SQL.
· Designed, created, and implemented data integration of providers and groups into inhouse system using .NET and SQL.
· Developed and maintained in Visual Studio the inhouse website for managing Providers and Groups.
· Checked the Source code into GITEA.
· Created custom code for automation of tasks including merging data into PDF and Word documents
And emailing to Providers and Groups.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Executed programming in C#, writing SQL Server Reporting Services reports and stored procedures in SQL Server.
· Designed, created, and implemented data migrations using C# and SQLite.
· Developed in SalesLogix by adding data fields / relations and modifying the forms for the new data fields.
· Created custom code for SalesLogix using C#.
· Used Dojo JavaScript controls and JSON in the SalesLogix website.
· Executed in Visual Studio, BIDS, and SalesLogix.

positions.title: Contract Consultant
positions.description:
Provided technical services and support to allow companies to operate more efficiently.
· Delivered SQL Server maintenance, stored procedures, and views / backups.
· Spearheaded consulting server setup, disaster recovery, and maintenance plans.

positions.title: Developer
positions.description:
Completed programming in ASP.NET, VB .NET, wrote SQL Server Reporting Services reports, managed Microsoft CRM 3.0, and wrote stored procedures in SQL Server 2005.
· Designed, created, and implemented complex data migrations using scripting and SQL Server Integration Services packages.
· Setup SQL Server Replication from Birmingham to California.
· Setup up notifications from SQL Server.
· Leveraged Microsoft Dynamics GP 9 which was upgraded to GP 10 and Microsoft CRM.
